summary.text: The original crash was reproduced and the fix stops port(None) from raising, but Break My Fix found two inputs that still break it: port('') raises ValueError, and Listener(default_port=9000).port(None) returns 8080 instead of the configured default. The most important thing to look at next is the second finding, since it suggests the fix returns a hardcoded 8080 rather than the listener's own de…

+++ b/src/gateway/listener.py
@@ -18,3 +18,3 @@
         """
-        if raw is None:
+        if raw is None or raw == "":
             return 8080
